description: §52.13.2 (S449 ruling item 4; g-auth-attr-empty-string-is-silent-and-public) — `<program auth="">` is E-AUTH-ATTR-INVALID. Before S449 the empty string was skipped as a 'boolean attribute' and compiled SILENTLY to a public app — the one literal with no diagnostic at all.
rationale: The ruling names `""` explicitly. Ruling: user-voice-scrml.md S449 "RULED — 'your recs.'" item 4 — 'Unrecognized / non-literal `auth=` (incl. `""`) = (a): compile error; amend §52.13.2 (supersedes its W-ATTR-002 + "no auth gate" SHALL).'
